page_summary: Web application dashboard for https://omnisight.local/dashboard showing navigation bar, hero analytics card, and action controls.

issues.title: Hero subtitle overlaps primary action button
issues.description: The subtitle text block line-height extends downwards and collides with the top 15px of the primary call-to-action button.

suggested_fix.explanation: Add bottom margin to push the button below the text block and normalize line height.

issues.title: Secondary action button misaligned vertically with primary button
issues.description: Secondary 'Learn More' button has an inconsistent top margin offset of 6px relative to the 'Get Started' primary button.

suggested_fix.explanation: Align button group container with flexbox align-items center and a consistent 12px gap.

issues.title: Metric card title clipped by container boundary
issues.description: The title 'Total Converted Registrations (Q4)' is clipped horizontally because the parent container has overflow: hidden and fixed width.

suggested_fix.css_code: .metric-card-title { text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; max-width: 100%; }
suggested_fix.explanation: Apply standard text truncation with ellipsis to prevent harsh clipping.

issues.title: Horizontal overflow and broken column wrapping on smaller viewports
issues.description: The three-column metrics grid does not wrap, forcing a horizontal scrollbar on viewports under 1024px.

suggested_fix.css_code: .metrics-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 16px; }
suggested_fix.explanation: Use responsive auto-fit grid columns with a 280px minimum to automatically wrap without horizontal overflow.
